Name: CheatShell
Description: Manage CheatShell and its configuration files.

Children.Name: Create project cheatfile
Children.Description: Download the example if missing, then open it in nano.

Children.Name: Open project cheatfile
Children.Description: Edit the current project's cheatfile.json in nano.

Children.Name: Download system cheatfile
Children.Description: Download and validate the system cheatfile, replacing the installed configuration.

Children.Name: Open system cheatfile
Children.Description: Edit the system-wide cheatfile in nano.

Children.Name: CheatShell management
Children.Description: Update CheatShell and manage its menu.

Children.Name: Update CheatShell
Children.Description: Download, validate, and update CheatShell and its management menu.
Command: echo 'CheatShell and management menu updated successfully.'

Children.Name: Open CheatShell menu
Children.Description: Edit the installed management menu in nano.

Children.Name: Remove CheatShell menu
Children.Description: Delete the management menu. CheatShell will download it again on the next launch.
